read_budget.description: The most characters of block text one page of `turns` carries. Rows go whole while the page stays within it, and `next` names the first row left for the next page; the first row of a page always goes, its text cut at the budget and marked `cut` when it alone is larger, so a reader always moves on.

scan_budget.description: The most wall rows of the round one `sessions` read takes, newest first after `since`. A round with more rows is answered out of the newest this many and `truncated: true`; it is never cut short in silence. Only rows the round may see count (the store's `covers`, GH #932).

description.purpose: An app reads its round off the wall (GH #949): one `in_read` question -- `hop.read_tag`, the body `{what, session_id?, since?, limit?}` -- answered on `read` out of this hive's ledger alone. `turns` are the wall rows of the round oldest first after the cursor `since` (a `seq`), optionally of one session, each with `seq`, `session_id`, `turn_id`, `kind`, `origin`, `final`, `at` and the `text` of its block, at most `limit` (default 20, at most 100) and `read_budget` characters a page, `next` the cursor of the rest or '' at the end; `sessions` are the sessions of the round with their first and last row and their number of turns, newest first. The round is `context.audience_set` and nothing else: every read selects through the store's `covers`, so a row reaches the round only when its own audience holds the round (or names `*`), a row without an audience reaches no round, and a read without a round -- none, or the declared empty one -- is refused `missing_audience` before a single ledger read.
description.use_when: Inside the curator only; the parent routes `hop.route == 'in_read'` onto the hive and takes `read` back out of its rim, matched by `hop.read_tag`. An app of a member reaches it through `install_app` `reads`.
description.not_in_scope: No write, no mark, no model: deterministic ledger reads. No other round: the round is never read out of the body or out of a row, and a round-less read is refused, never served the running session's undeclared rows the way the model's own window is. No search and no ranking -- the model's `history_*` tools (`./history`) are another contract.
description.emits_meaning: read: the answer, `{messages: [], rows, next, truncated}` with `hop.read_tag` and `hop.read_what` echoed (bounded), `hop.error_code` (empty, `missing_audience`, `invalid_input`, `store_error`) and `hop.detail` (the key a refused question failed on for `invalid_input` -- `read_tag`, `what`, `session_id`, `since` or `limit` --, the store's error code for `store_error`); a refusal carries no rows and is never an empty page of an answer. lstore: the ledger reads of a question.
description.consumes_meaning: in_read (`hop.read_tag`, the round in `context.audience_set`, the body's `what`, `session_id`, `since`, `limit`) and the ledger's answers to its phases (turns, turns-2, sessions).
